The '''Otoh Gunga Challenge''' was a sports racing event that was held in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was open to anyone with a single engine sub, able to achieve a speed of at least 100 [[longo]]s and fast enough to outswim any [[klaa fish]].<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

After the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Challenge was held, which saw tourists arrive and witness the bongo racing at the [[Otoh Gunga Garden/Legends|Otoh Gunga Garden]] bubble.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

At one race, two aggressive racers, [[Neb Neb Goodrow]] and [[Spleed Nukkels]], crashed, forcing them both to eject from their subs, and leading to the disappearance of [[Zak Quiglee|Zak "Squidfella" Quiglee]]. [[Brooboo Seep]] was the eventual winner of the tumultuous race. The following race, the two crashed again, to the amusement and delight of the fans.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

==Rules of the game==
The rules of the game specifically stated that no weapons were allowed whatsoever, regardless if they were equipped on a sub or carried by a participant. This meant that military subs were prohibited unless they were decommissioned and unarmed; in other words, in the defenceless state of all other participating subs. These were the only restrictions for anyone entering into the competition. Otherwise, the rules were wide open for contestants.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Otoh Gunga Challenge appears in the short story ''[[Deep Spoilers]]'', printed in [[Star Wars Gamer 4|''Star Wars Gamer'' 4]] magazine.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />
